decisions.reason: Disabling mobile hover animations does not change the gallery category tabs or optional photography area.
The interactive scrolling behavior remains required unchanged; hover animation is an independent gallery interaction.
Button navigation is addressed by a separate clause in the source message and is not changed by the mobile-hover decision.
The mobile pricing-table request is a separate decision and is not logically changed by disabling gallery hover animations.
The one-time pricing model and hidden recurring-pricing tabs are unrelated to mobile gallery hover behavior.
Disabling mobile hover animations does not alter individual-service display, selection, or pricing transparency.
The homepage hero image emphasis and blue overlay presentation remain unchanged.
Package counts, square-footage ranges, and displayed prices are unaffected by the mobile-hover setting.
Service-specific imagery remains required and does not depend on gallery hover animations.
Removing a mobile interaction effect does not change the requirement for a highly visual, image-focused presentation.
The mobile-hover preference does not negate or modify the general responsive-layout claim for desktop, tablet, and mobile.
